meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 当你要它做 GitHub 分诊时,它会读取仓库中所有打开的 issue 和 PR,给每一项生成一份分析报告存到临时文件夹;报告里的每个结论都必须附上对应的 GitHub 代码链接作证据。它全程只读,绝不会在 GitHub 上评论、合并或关闭任何内容。
howto.when: 当你说出 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等触发词,或要求对 GitHub 仓库的打开的 issue/PR 做分诊时,它会接管并开始逐项分析。

say.text: 帮我 triage 这个仓库的 open issues。
say.note: 它会读取所有打开的 issue 并逐条写报告。

say.text: triage PRs,把每个 PR 的分析写在 /tmp 报告里。
say.note: 它分析每个打开的 PR,只写不改。

say.text: github triage,看看现在有哪些需要处理的 issue 和 PR。
say.note: 它会全量分析并生成报告,但不会改动仓库。

howto.what_en: When triggered with triage words, it reads all open issues/PRs, analyzes each item via a background task, and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp. Every claim needs a GitHub permalink. It never comments, merges, closes, or labels on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or similar requests to analyze a GitHub repo's open items. It then starts a read-only triage across all open issues and PRs.

say_en.text: Triage the open issues in this repository.
say_en.note: It reads all open issues and writes a report per item.

say_en.text: Triage PRs and write each analysis to the /tmp report.
say_en.note: It analyzes each open PR and only writes reports.

say_en.text: GitHub triage, see which issues and PRs need attention now.
say_en.note: It analyzes everything and produces reports without changing the repo.
